title.zh: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
title.en: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇

current_state.zh: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.
current_state.en: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.
